closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin B12, omega 3, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low zinc, low collagen, and the outcome depends heavily on preparation. It's good for blood and oxygen support, hormone health, and bone health because vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side, the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role, and vitamin D and magnesium can support bones.
